paragraphs.text: Jerrard of the Closed Fist is a legendary knight from the Kb'Briann Highlands whose lifetime on Dominaria is unknown.

Jerrard is the last remaining member of the Order of the Closed Fist. Clad in formidable armor and armed with a halberd and shield adorned with symbolic imagery, Jerrard rides an armored steed. He appears to be left-handed.
Jerrard's lifetime is unknown, as legendary creatures from the Legends set are from many points in time, meaning he may be long deceased, currently alive, or even yet to be born.
